reconstruction.summary: A stored exact-real producer computes right Gram environments by contracting local core slices with one recursively obtained stored tail environment. With scalar boundaries it returns the Euclidean norm of the full real tensor-train amplitude family. The full word sum is a specification, not the producer's evaluation schedule. Explicit Run counters include arithmetic, stored reads, full materialization passes, terminal identity decisions and fixed chain-node records.
reconstruction.carriers: StoredMatrix N M = Vector (Vector R M) N, not an arbitrary callback. StoredCore l m = StoredMatrix l (2*m). StoredChain is dependent nil r : StoredChain 0 r r and cons A(l,2*m) tail(n,m,r) : StoredChain(n+1,l,r). All dimensions natural, including zero; all entries real.
reconstruction.word_and_address_order: Word 0=Unit; Word(n+1)=Fin 2 x Word n. Head core emits first tuple bit and contract multiplies slices in head-to-tail order. finProdFinEquiv address is j+m*bit (equivalently bit*m+j), so local stored columns are bit-0 block followed by bit-1 block, each with right-bond index varying fastest. No conversion to integer basis indices or little-/big-endian quantum wire order is supplied by this module.
reconstruction.general_gram_formula: G_C[a,c]=sum x:Word n, sum t:Fin r, contract(C,x)[a,t]*contract(C,x)[c,t]. Terminal nil is I_r, not a selected terminal index or an all-ones boundary. All terminal labels are retained. Scalar norm specializes l=r=1, square-roots G[0,0], and preserves signs only through their squared contributions.
reconstruction.assumptions_and_binders: Definitions and correctness use only natural dimensions, stored tables/chains and appropriate Fin indices. update correctness permits any real stored E, not just a Gram/PSD matrix. norm takes only C:StoredChain n 1 1. Cost theorems take arbitrary op:Op; global cost additionally takes D:Nat and maxBond(denoteChain C)<=D, where maxBond includes initial, intermediate and terminal dimensions. No positivity/nonzero/rank/canonicalization/oracle/access/circuit premise is hidden in the norm interface.
reconstruction.run_semantics: Run alpha has a value and an Op->Nat counter. pure supplies zero counters; bind obtains y=f x.value then returns y.value and pointwise x.cost+y.cost. This is a denotational counted producer, not operational semantics for a compiled runtime. charge attaches one tick to a mathematical value. Scalars are arbitrary exact Reals, primitives noncomputable.
reconstruction.charging_and_materialization: Op has field,sqrt,angle,trig,compare,read,write,emit. total sums all eight without weights. entry reads outer vector row and inner scalar (2 reads). sumEntries visits each Fin k callback once in its recursive schedule; each term uses one extra field add, including the final add-to-zero. collect first forms a vector of counted Run results, then maps values and sums stored counters; modeled overhead per collected element is two reads and two writes. Nested materialize charges (N*M+N)*(2 read+2 write) beyond supplied per-cell cost; N outer row references are charged even when M=0. Metadata/counter aggregation and proof work are excluded.
reconstruction.cache_and_schedule: gram recursively binds the tail result once; both physical-bit branches read the same stored E. update creates four stored contraction outputs plus a stored sum; secondEntry uses A at reversed indices instead of constructing a free transpose. cacheNode merely adds the stipulated 3 read+3 write allowance at each cons/nil. The recurrence avoids evaluating dense Word n amplitudes. Sharing is present in the stated schedule, but pointer aliasing, garbage collection, evaluation strategy and actual runtime caching have no separate proved refinement.
reconstruction.zero_empty_and_deficient: nil 1 represents the single empty-word contraction 1, hence norm 1 and modeled total cost 18. nil 0 has empty Gram and no identity cells, but six node overhead remains. Zero inner bonds yield empty sums=0 and no scalar callbacks; materialization still accounts for outer row slots. l=0 update has no rows, but recursive tail and node costs remain. No divisions or zero-pivot branch occur in this supplier; deficient and all-zero real cores are admitted, giving zero norm when every amplitude vanishes. Scalar boundaries force maxBond>=1, so D=0 cannot satisfy a scalar-chain bond bound.
